skill.name: performance-profiler
skill.description: Analyze code performance patterns, estimate bottleneck impact, and recommend practical optimization steps.
skill.summary: Find performance bottlenecks in application code and prioritize improvements.
skill.author: CuriousLearner

content.value_statement: Slow code can hide inside algorithms, rendering, database queries, and bundles. This skill reviews source patterns and produces prioritized optimization guidance.
actual_capabilities: Reviews algorithms for time and space complexity risks.
Flags frontend re-render, memoization, and cleanup issues.
Identifies N+1 database query patterns and batching opportunities.
Highlights bundle size risks from large dependencies and broad imports.
Ranks issues by impact and suggests practical optimization steps.
limitations: Does not run benchmarks unless the host agent executes profiling tools separately.
Performance gains are estimates until measured with realistic data.
Needs relevant source files or reports to produce useful findings.
Cannot replace production monitoring or load testing.

use_cases.title: Review Frontend Rendering
use_cases.description: Find avoidable re-renders, expensive calculations, missing cleanup, and oversized imports in UI code.

use_cases.title: Optimize Backend Data Access
use_cases.description: Spot N+1 queries, blocking work, inefficient loops, and caching opportunities in service code.

use_cases.title: Plan Performance Work
use_cases.description: Turn many possible bottlenecks into a ranked action list with expected impact and trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Scan One File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single source file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use performance-profiler on this file. Identify the highest impact bottlenecks and explain each recommendation in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Focus On React
prompt_templates.prompt: Use performance-profiler on these React components. Focus on re-renders, memoization, event cleanup, and expensive render-time calculations.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use performance-profiler on this service flow. Check algorithms, database queries, blocking operations, caching, and memory allocation patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create Optimization Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use performance-profiler across this project. Produce a prioritized roadmap with expected impact, implementation risk, and measurement steps.

output_examples.input: Review a component that recalculates filtered table rows on every render.
output_examples.output: High priority: memoize the filtered rows and stabilize props. Expected result is lower render time during table updates.

output_examples.input: Review an API endpoint that loads authors inside a posts loop.
output_examples.output: Critical issue: likely N+1 database access. Use eager loading or batching, then measure request latency with realistic post counts.

output_examples.input: Review a bundle report with large date and utility libraries.
output_examples.output: Medium priority: replace broad imports with smaller modules. Verify savings with a bundle analyzer before and after the change.

best_practices: Provide representative data sizes, traffic patterns, and current performance symptoms.
Ask for measurement steps so each recommendation can be verified.
Prioritize bottlenecks that affect users before small code style changes.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize code without profiling or a clear performance symptom.
Do not apply every recommendation without checking readability and maintainability.
Do not rely on estimated gains when real benchmark data is available.

faq.question: Does this skill run performance benchmarks?
faq.answer: It can recommend benchmark commands, but actual execution depends on the host agent and project tools.

faq.question: Which languages does it support best?
faq.answer: The examples focus on JavaScript, React, Node.js, databases, and bundle analysis patterns.

faq.question: Can it analyze database performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It looks for query patterns such as N+1 access, missing batching, and inefficient data loading.

faq.question: Can it estimate performance gains?
faq.answer: Yes. It can estimate likely impact, but measurements are needed to confirm real gains.

faq.question: Does it change code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides recommendations and examples. Code changes require a separate editing request.

faq.question: What input gives the best results?
faq.answer: Provide source files, profiling output, bundle reports, slow queries, or a clear performance complaint.
